Content: MemorySmith chat is provider-based. IChatProvider isolates model API calls/model discovery and IChatAgent isolates memory/page context gathering and agent-write behavior. OllamaChatProvider is the current local provider using /api/chat and /api/tags on the configured Ollama endpoint. MemoryChatAgent builds context from hybrid memory search plus markdown page search, loads the shared system prompt from Prompts/wiki-chat-agent.md, and can include text attachment context. Chat mode answers questions; Agent mode can parse structured provider output and write MemoryRecord entries and Data/Pages markdown pages when Chat:AgentWritesEnabled is true. The /chat UI supports provider model selection, Send on Enter, local chat history, attachments, status display, and clickable memory/page resource chips. The design leaves room for OpenAI, Copilot, Anthropic, or other providers without changing the UI or agent workflow.
Title: Chat Agent Provider Architecture
